scope: G4 Curie fragment TEX BX2 decoding and lowering.

nativeTrigger.operation: TEX.H1.yzw has instruction bit 21 set. That bit was previously discarded by the decoder.

change: Decode the TEX expansion flag. For normalized sampled components, apply 2*x-1 before instruction scaling, saturation, half conversion and predicate commit. Preserve crossbar constant lanes. Float texture formats ignore BX2. Unsupported combined depth/gamma/signed conversions trap explicitly before any GPU draw.

validation.red: Real WebGPU regression with the original converter fails: TEX BX2 signed range lane 0 remains 0.501953125, 0.2509765625, 0, 1.
validation.green: Actual WebGPU tests cover signed negative results through RGBA32F targets, H/R destinations, instruction scaling, saturation, crossbar constants and float-format bypass. Entire existing GPU suite passes.
other: Full texture and graph suites pass.

nativeReplay.guest: Original XP 93.71 05 GT1, same saved active scene, release build and standard batching.
nativeReplay.finding: The original scene continues to render, but blue materials persist. BX2 was a real missing operation, not the complete explanation of that image defect. No score or full-suite completion is claimed.

diagnostics: Default-off NV_DIAGNOSTIC_DRAW_CAUSE_ALL optionally retains bounded pixel-event causes for non-black colors; this identified the original lighting instruction.
